theme: tuning a radiator network to a prescribed cooling curve
title: Radiator Network: Multi-Scale Cooling-Curve Match
strategies: half-cap baseline: set every edge weight to floor(cap/2), ignoring both the targets and the topology (reproduces the checker's own baseline, ~0.1)

single global scale: search one shared scale factor beta in [0,1] and set every edge weight to round(beta*cap), fitting the whole time grid at once with one shared knob -- the obvious first approach, but a single knob cannot move the short-time and long-time regimes independently

bridge/interior decoupling: find the graph's bridge edges (Tarjan bridge-finding on the topology alone), fit a single interior scale against the short-time (moment-dominated) targets, then exhaustively search the few bridge weights against the long-time (spectral-gap-dominated) targets, and refine -- exploits the planted structural split
further local refinement on top of the decoupled solution (per-edge nudges, alternating re-fits) squeezes out additional headroom
